items.title: Duffy Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 17, 1995
items.q: my father and © Fillius Jazz Archive -14- Lena were associated together in Charlie Barnet’s big band in the early 40s before my dad joined Woody Herman’s band.

ctx.x: And within five hours after that I was on a flight to California. I packed my bags and dad put me on the plane and Ray Brown met me at the airport and drove me to the hotel and left me there, and like the next day I opened up with Teddy Edwards on sax, Milt Jackson, Ray Brown, Monty Alexander and myself. And for three weeks I was in a dream world like you would not believe, to play with these people. And right after that I got a phone call, now let me preface it, Louie Bellson has been a saint in my life. He…
Lena were associated together in Charlie Barnet’s big band in the early 40s before my dad joined Woody Herman’s band. So Lena took extra special care of her little Chubby.
